quote: A monk asked Joshu, "Does a dog have a Buddha-nature or not?" Joshu answered, "Mu."
author: Joshu Jushin

quote: If you meet the Buddha on the road, kill him.
author: Linji Yixuan

quote: "You can hear the sound of two hands when they are clapped together," said Hakuin. "Now show me the sound of one hand."
author: Hakuin Ekaku

quote: What was your original face before your parents were born?
author: Huineng

quote: Two monks were arguing about a flag. One said, "The flag is moving." The other said, "The wind is moving." The Sixth Patriarch said, "Not the wind, not the flag; mind is moving."
author: Huineng

quote: A monk asked Joshu, "I have just entered the monastery. Please teach me." Joshu asked, "Have you eaten your rice porridge?" The monk replied, "I have eaten." Joshu said, "Then you had better wash your bowl."
author: Joshu Jushin

quote: Nansen saw monks of the eastern and western halls quarreling over a cat. He held up the cat and said, "If you can say a word of Zen, you will save the cat. If not, I will kill it." No one could answer, so Nansen cut the cat in two.
author: Nansen Fugan

quote: Like this cup, you are full of your own opinions and speculations. How can I show you Zen unless you first empty your cup?
author: Nan-in

quote: A monk asked Tozan, "How can we escape the cold and heat?" Tozan said, "Why not go where there is no cold and heat?" The monk asked, "Is there such a place?" Tozan said, "When cold, be thoroughly cold; when hot, be thoroughly hot."
author: Tozan Shusho

quote: Unmon said, "I don't ask you about before the fifteenth day, but what about after the fifteenth day?" Unmon himself answered, "Every day is a good day."
author: Unmon Bun'en

quote: A monk asked Unmon, "What is Buddha?" Unmon said, "A dried shit-stick."
author: Unmon Bun'en

quote: A monk asked Joshu, "What is the meaning of the Patriarch's coming from the West?" Joshu said, "The cypress tree in the courtyard."
author: Joshu Jushin

quote: The master Baso was sick. A monk asked, "How are you?" Baso said, "Sun-faced Buddha, Moon-faced Buddha."
author: Baso Matsu

quote: Shuzan held out his short staff and said, "If you call this a short staff, you oppose its reality. If you do not call it a short staff, you ignore the fact. Now what do you wish to call this?"
author: Shuzan

quote: Whenever Gutei was asked about Zen, he simply raised his finger.
author: Gutei

quote: Emperor Wu asked Bodhidharma, "What is the highest meaning of the holy truths?" Bodhidharma said, "Vast emptiness, no holiness." The Emperor said, "Who is it that stands before me?" Bodhidharma said, "I don't know."
author: Bodhidharma

quote: To study the Buddha Way is to study the self. To study the self is to forget the self. To forget the self is to be actualized by myriad things. When this happens, your body and mind as well as the bodies and minds of others drop away.
author: Dogen

quote: Sitting quietly, doing nothing, spring comes, and the grass grows by itself.
author: Zenrin Kushu

quote: Before enlightenment; chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment; chop wood, carry water.
author: Wu Li

quote: Joshu asked Nansen, "What is the Way?" Nansen answered, "Ordinary mind is the Way." "Should I direct myself toward it?" asked Joshu. "If you try to direct yourself toward it, you go against it," said Nansen.
author: Nansen Fugan

quote: A young goose is raised in a bottle. It grows so large it cannot get out of the bottle. The owner doesn't want to break the bottle, and he doesn't want to hurt the goose. How would you get it out?
author: Rikyu

quote: A monk asked Hyakujo, "Does an enlightened man fall under the law of causation?" Hyakujo answered, "He does not ignore the law of causation."
author: Hyakujo Ekai

quote: A monk asked Baso, "What is Buddha?" Baso replied, "This mind is Buddha."
author: Baso Matsu

quote: A monk asked Baso, "What is Buddha?" Baso replied, "No mind, no Buddha."
author: Baso Matsu

quote: Let go or be dragged.
author: Zen Proverb

quote: Ryokan sat naked, watching the moon. "Poor fellow," he mused after a thief took his clothes, "I wish I could have given him this beautiful moon."
author: Ryokan Taigu

quote: The obstacle is the path.
author: Zen Proverb

quote: From the beginning, all beings are Buddha. This very place is the Lotus Land, this very body the Buddha.
author: Hakuin Ekaku

quote: Zen is not some kind of excitement, but concentration on our usual everyday routine.
author: Shunryu Suzuki

quote: Each of you is perfect the way you are... and you can use a little improvement.
author: Shunryu Suzuki

quote: Kyogen said, "It is like a man up a tree, hanging from a branch by his teeth. His hands cannot grasp a bough. Another man asks him, 'What is the meaning of Bodhidharma's coming from the West?' If he does not answer, he fails. If he does answer, he will fall and lose his life. What should he do?"
author: Kyogen Chikan

quote: Seizei said to Sozan, "I am alone and poor. I beg you, Master, help me." Sozan said, "Venerable Seizei!" "Yes, Master!" replied Seizei. Sozan said, "You have already drunk three cups of the finest wine, and still you say your lips are not yet moist."
author: Sozan

quote: The moon's the same old moon, the flowers' the same old flowers, yet I've become the thingness of all the things I see.
author: Bunan

quote: A master picked up a tile and began to polish it. A monk asked, "What are you doing?" The master replied, "I am polishing this tile to make a mirror." The monk asked, "How can polishing a tile make a mirror?" The master replied, "How can sitting in zazen make you a Buddha?"
author: Nanyue Huairang

quote: The Great Way is not difficult for those who have no preferences.
author: Seng-ts'an

quote: When the Buddha held up a flower, everyone was silent. Only Mahakasyapa smiled.
author: Buddha

quote: Flowing water is not stagnant. A rolling stone gathers no moss.
author: Zen Proverb

quote: A monk asked, "What is the one word?" Joshu replied, "If you hold on to a word, you will be lost."
author: Joshu Jushin

quote: The whole moon and the entire sky are reflected in one dewdrop on the grass.
author: Dogen

quote: Hogen pointed to the bamboo blinds. Two monks went and rolled them up. Hogen said, "One gains, one loses."
author: Hogen

quote: When you walk, just walk. When you sit, just sit. Above all, don't wobble.
author: Ummon Bun'en

quote: The wild geese do not intend to cast their reflection; the water has no mind to receive their image.
author: Zenrin Kushu

quote: Tokusan used to say, "If you can say a word, thirty blows. If you cannot say a word, thirty blows."
author: Tokusan Senkan

quote: Baso and Hyakujo saw wild ducks fly by. Baso asked, "What is that?" "Wild ducks," said Hyakujo. "Where have they gone?" asked Baso. "They have flown away," replied Hyakujo. Baso twisted Hyakujo's nose. "You say they have flown away," said Baso, "but they have been here all the time."
author: Baso Matsu

quote: Do not seek the truth, only cease to cherish opinions.
author: Seng-ts'an

quote: The real miracle is not to walk on water or in thin air, but to walk on earth.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh

quote: One day Gutei was about to die. He told the assembled monks, "I received one-finger Zen from Tenryu. I used it all my life but could not exhaust it." Then he raised his finger, and passed away.
author: Gutei

quote: A monk asked Seppo, "What is Buddha?" Seppo, remaining silent, smacked him with his staff.
author: Seppo Gison

quote: Bankei's Zen was to live in the Unborn. He told his students, "You were all unborn. When you're abiding in the Unborn, you're abiding in the Buddha Mind."
author: Bankei Yotaku

quote: One who seeks the Way is like one who is walking in the mist. Though he may not be wet, yet his clothes are gradually moistened.
author: Muso Soseki
